description: Remove duplicate lines from any list, with options to ignore case, trim spaces and sort.

faqs.a: The first occurrence of each line is kept and later repeats are dropped, so the original order is preserved unless you enable sorting.
faqs.q: Which copy is kept when lines repeat?

faqs.a: Yes. With "ignore case" on, "Apple" and "apple" count as the same line and only the first one is kept.
faqs.q: Does it treat "Apple" and "apple" as duplicates?

faqs.a: No. Everything runs locally in your browser — your list never leaves your device.

howto: Paste your list, one item per line, into the text area.
Choose options: ignore case, trim whitespace, sort A-Z.
Copy or download the cleaned list; the removed-duplicates count is shown below.
title: Duplicate Line Remover
